title: amellus novi-belgii
intro: Amellus novi-belgii, commonly known as New York aster, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its multiple health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of New York aster are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may help in soothing skin irritations, calming the nervous system, and promoting wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities, making it a valuable resource in natural medicine.
